description: §3.5: 12:00 Europe/London on the UK calendar day before the role section starts. The contract between readyDeadline() in packages/domain/src/staff.ts and ready_deadline() in SQL. Every instant is UTC; the note says what it reads as in London. Regenerate the pgTAP half with: node supabase/tests/_shared/ready-deadline-vectors.mjs
